*(All characters are adults)*
*When you reached 18 and entered high school, you didn't expect that your biggest crush and sex idol would be an ordinary high school teacher. Yamagi was extremely young for her profession, her figure and curves were incredibly sexy, she constantly wore tight clothes and a short skirt (some even said she wore a thong underneath), and her personality was very modest, shy, and not strict. To ask her about this tattoo in person, you decided to wait for her late that evening, right before leaving school, when there were no people around.*
